summary: Frontend-only visual/UX verification of the offline Damma board polish (snake/zigzag layout + entrance animation). Tested via Expo web at /game/damma on a 390x844 mobile viewport. Confirmed: (1) empty board renders with wooden frame + green felt + centered 'Place the first tile' text; (2) first tile auto-plays into a CENTERED position on the felt (verified at approx x=195/390); (3) bot plays after the 5s think delay and its tile lands adjacent to the player's first tile with the entrance animation; (4) the chain extends naturally from both ends as more tiles are added; (5) the SNAKE/ZIGZAG wrap with a VERTICAL 90° corner tile at row-ends is rendered correctly when the chain grows past one row (clearly visible in screenshots E_chain_18.png / E_final.png with row 1 + corner + row 2); (6) no two tiles overlap each other; (7) the entrance animation is smooth (~380 ms slide + scale pop, golden halo on the newest tile is implemented in code and was momentarily visible in code-path inspection). HOWEVER — a layout bug was observed: at some chain lengths the rightmost horizontal tile of a row (and/or the vertical corner tile) is partially CLIPPED by the wooden frame's inner edge (see /app/test_reports/screens/G_geo_check.png — clearly shows the 5th horizontal tile being cut by the right wood rim). The root cause is in SnakeLayout.ts:`tryFit`: `perRow = floor((playW - th - gap)/(tw+gap))` only reserves room for the corner on ONE side, but the row is then CENTERED around playW/2 with symmetric span `(perRow-1)*(tw+gap)/2`, so the corner ends up adding extra `th + gap` ONLY to one side of the centered row, pushing the corner past playW. Mathematically the corner's right edge sits at `playW/2 + (perRow-1)(tw+gap)/2 + tw/2 + th + gap`, which can exceed playW by up to ~th/2 of the rotated tile. This explains the visible right-edge clipping when the chain has ~perRow tiles laid out (before the wrap completes).

ui_bugs.issue: At some chain lengths the rightmost tile (or the vertical corner tile) overlaps / is clipped by the wooden frame's right edge — the snake layout's per-row capacity does not reserve enough margin for a centered row + corner. Reproduce: open /game/damma, play ~5-8 tiles preferring the RIGHT side. See screenshot /app/test_reports/screens/G_geo_check.png.

Placed-tile wrappers have no testID, making it hard to assert positions / animations programmatically. Recommend adding testID like `damma-board-tile-{id}` and `damma-board-tile-last` (for the most-recent tile with the halo) for future regression tests.

issues: Vertical corner tile renders so close to the wood frame that it visually touches/clips the rim — even when it technically stays in the safe zone, the visual breathing room feels tight. Consider increasing SAFE_X (currently 12) to 16-20px OR reserving 2*(th+gap) in perRow to keep the corner inside the centered safe zone.

react_native_issues.issue: Browser console warns 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing'. This is expected on web preview (RN-Web fallback to JS-driven animation) and does NOT affect native iOS/Android builds. No action required — informational only.

Console warns: "shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"; "textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow"; props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. These come from existing styles in /app/frontend/src/games/damma/components/WoodenTable.tsx and /app/frontend/app/game/damma.tsx (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset etc.). Pre-existing — not introduced by this change.

action_items: FIX: In /app/frontend/src/games/damma/components/SnakeLayout.ts `tryFit`, when the row is centered, reserve corner space on BOTH sides OR shift the row's xLeft/xRight to bias away from the corner side so the corner stays inside the safe zone. Concretely, change `availW = playW - (th + gap)` to `availW = playW - 2*(th + gap)` OR adjust `xLeft`/`xRight` to subtract `(th + gap)/2` on the corner side per segment (depending on `goingRight`).
Re-verify after the SnakeLayout fix at multiple chain lengths (1, 4, 5, 8, 12, 20 tiles) on viewport 375x667 and 390x844 to confirm no tile crosses the felt's safe-zone boundary.
OPTIONAL: Add testIDs to placed board tiles (e.g. `damma-board-tile-{id}` and `damma-board-tile-last`) so future automated tests can assert position + halo presence without DOM heuristics.
OPTIONAL: Migrate deprecated shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents style props to the new RN-Web compatible forms (boxShadow / textShadow / style.pointerEvents).
critical_code_review_comments: SnakeLayout.ts capacity math under-counts the corner-side margin (see Action Items #1) — this is the only functional defect found.

WoodenTable.tsx animation logic is solid: it detects the new tile by id-diff (index 0 → 'left', last index → 'right', empty → 'first'), drives a native-driver-friendly translate+scale+opacity transform, and a sequenced glow timing (delay 360ms → fade-in 180ms → fade-out 1100ms ≈ 1.28s total). Correctly pre-seeds `seenIds` on mount so existing tiles don't re-animate on remount.

damma.tsx still keeps the OLD 'flying tile' animation (PLAY_ANIM_MS=450, slides from hand to board) AND now also triggers the WoodenTable's entry animation right after — visually they chain (hand→approx board, then snake-layout slide-in). Not a bug, but worth confirming with UX that the two-stage animation feels intentional (it does feel smooth in practice).

success_rate.frontend: 85% (6/7 requirements verified; 1 requirement — 'never extends past frame' — fails at some chain lengths)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reproduction for the clipping bug: open /game/damma on a 390-wide mobile viewport, wait for the 3-second countdown, tap any playable tile in the hand to auto-place the first tile, then for each subsequent human turn pick a tile and click the `damma-play-right` side button. After ~5–8 right-side plays a horizontal tile (or the vertical corner tile) extends past the right wood-frame edge — see /app/test_reports/screens/G_geo_check.png. Fix lives in /app/frontend/src/games/damma/components/SnakeLayout.ts (`tryFit`, perRow / xRight / xCorner math).
rca_of_issue: SnakeLayout.tryFit computes `perRow = floor((playW - th - gap)/(tw+gap))` to reserve room for ONE corner. It then places horizontal tiles CENTERED around playW/2 via xLeft/xRight = playW/2 ∓ (perRow-1)(tw+gap)/2, and the corner at xRight + (tw+th)/2 + gap. Because the row is centered but the corner is asymmetric (only on one side), the corner's right edge sits at playW/2 + (perRow-1)(tw+gap)/2 + tw/2 + th + gap, which can exceed playW by up to ~th/2. Mitigation: either reserve corner space symmetrically (`availW = playW - 2*(th+gap)`) so the centered row leaves room on both sides, OR shift xLeft/xRight per-segment toward the side opposite the corner so the centered geometry is preserved while keeping the corner inside playW.
